# Yuval Karako

Yuval Karako is a graduate researcher in AI & Biotechnology (M.Sc.) at Bar-Ilan University's Marine Ecosystem Dynamics Lab, where he leads an AI research project that moves from detecting ecological change to explaining its causes. He is the AI research lead on a 2026 BIU AI Convergence seed grant with Prof. Carmit Altman and Dr. Gal Eyal. He teaches agentic AI and personal knowledge bases to senior faculty in HIGH AI, Bar-Ilan's flagship AI program for academics, and leads digital transformation in the IDF Education & Youth Corps.

## Profile

- [Home](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/): research, teaching, public service and contact.
- [Markdown profile](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/profile.md)

## Work

- [Research](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/research/text): My M.Sc. thesis builds an AI system that goes past labeling underwater images. It measures each coral, follows it over time, and when it finds damage, proposes likely causes based on 845 scientific papers. Most existing tools stop at the labeling step. Around it: a BIU AI Convergence grant with Prof. Carmit Altman, a systematic review, and a collaboration with the Technion.
- [Teaching agentic AI](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/teaching/text): I’m on the teaching faculty of HIGH AI, Bar-Ilan University’s flagship program for training senior academics in agentic AI. I teach its unit on building a personal knowledge base to deans, department heads and research-institute directors.
- [Digital transformation in the IDF](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/public-service/text): I head digital transformation in the IDF Education & Youth Corps, with end-to-end ownership of its software systems and digitization projects: from architecture and specification, through development and deployment, to the teams that build and maintain them.

## Research lines

- [Coherence to meaning: recovering structured meaning from imprecise descriptions](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/research#coherence-to-meaning) - BIU AI CONVERGENCE SEED GRANT · 2026–27 · AWARDED. People describe what they see in imprecise words. This project teaches a model to recover the structure behind those words, first in children’s narratives, then in divers’ reports of reef damage.
- [From detection to diagnosis: AI for coral reef decline](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/research#etiology-system) - M.SC. THESIS. An AI system that measures every coral in underwater images, follows each colony over time, and proposes likely causes when it finds damage.
- [From perception to causation: AI for marine ecological monitoring](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/research#systematic-review) - SYSTEMATIC REVIEW. A PRISMA 2020 systematic review mapping what AI for marine monitoring can do today, and where it stops short of ecological explanation.
- [Image analysis of reef settlement plates](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/research#settlement-plates) - COLLABORATION · TECHNION. Segmentation, annotation and color analysis of ceramic plates with different roughness and porosity, photographed over time, to follow how reef communities settle on them.
- [Research with AI over an indexed knowledge base](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/research#methods-paper) - METHODS PAPER. A methods paper on doing research with AI on top of an indexed, version-controlled knowledge base: the workflow I use in my own research and teach in HIGH AI.
